question: Which t2 through t5 requests can inspect lab at 10:00, and does t2 also authorize game?

criteria.instruction: t2 and t4 pass lab inspection at 10:00: exact scalar audience or exact list membership, inventory.read and current lab membership. t3's rowan-inventory-admin is not an exact audience match. t5's inventory.write is not the required inventory.read scope. t2 does not grant game membership, so game is denied.
Use A10 audience/scope rules, identity registry and disposable checks. No implied prefix, write-implies-read or cross-project permission is defined.
Do not endorse k8, prefix matching, administrator bypass or inferred game access to make failures disappear.
